name: ListOfBooks API
description: Read-only lookups of book series, reading orders and authors. Every result links to its page on listofbooks.net. Each call needs a free API key from https://www.listofbooks.net/developers, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`. A free key allows 10 calls per minute, 60 per hour and 200 per day, and 50 distinct series or author pages per day. All keys of one member share these limits.
